source_note: Public-path clerk lookup for the 23 Section 13 house lots whose first priced RPI sale is 2001+ or starts at $0. Nothing here is a complete original deed. Book/page and instrument values are official RPI pointers only.

paths_tried.name: Loudoun RPI Sales / Transfers
paths_tried.result: Current tax year (2026) is the only year that returns sales. Older taxyr values return empty. First-sale seller is blank on every gap lot. Instruments on later sales do not reveal the prior grantor/grantee without PAX.

paths_tried.name: Loudoun RPI profile legal description
paths_tried.result: Public. Yields book--page and/or instrument tokens on the legal line. These are pointers, not grantor/grantee/date/price.

paths_tried.name: Loudoun RPI permits (NEWCON)
paths_tried.result: Public. Every gap lot has a 1999 or early-2000 NEWCON permit, so the house existed in the original-sale window. A permit is not a deed and was not added to map sales.

paths_tried.name: Clerk PAX occasional-user index
paths_tried.result: Login wall. Free index after Create Account. Search/API routes without a session return 404. No account was created (would require inventing a personal identity). Stopped this path.

paths_tried.name: Clerk Online Land Records (county page)
paths_tried.result: Explains free occasional-user signup and $0.50/page images. Does not expose the index without an account.

paths_tried.name: LandMARC (Tyler EnerGov)
paths_tried.result: Permits and land-development applications, not the deed index. GIS LMARC/LandMARC_Permits is the same domain.

paths_tried.name: Loudoun GIS LandRecords / LandRecordData / LMIS platfile
paths_tried.result: No grantor/grantee/consideration. LMISVPC_PAR_CURR owner-start/sale dates are the current owner, not the 1999 builder.

paths_tried.name: Public Real Estate Sales Reports
paths_tried.result: Downloadable sales reports start 2013. Too late for 1999–2000 builder deeds.

paths_tried.name: Historic deed indexes
paths_tried.result: PDF indexes 1757–1903 only. FamilySearch / LVA films likewise stop far before 1999.

login_paul_must_do.system: Loudoun Clerk of the Circuit Court PAX — Occasional User (free index)
login_paul_must_do.what_to_create: A free occasional-user account in your own name (Create Account on the PAX page). Index lookup is free. Deed images are $0.50/page plus a convenience fee if you want copies.
login_paul_must_do.in_person_free: Public kiosks, Clerk’s Office, 18 E Market St, Leesburg, Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. No account needed.
login_paul_must_do.staff_email: HistoricRecords@loudoun.gov (they will not run the research; they can help with instrument/page counts once you have a cite)
how_to_search: Instrument Search with each lot’s first-RPI instrument and check Include Cross References
Instrument Search by Book + Page for the three lots that still show a 1711–1786 book on the RPI legal line (18, 19, 46)
Advanced/Legal Search for BROADLANDS SEC 13 LOT <n>
Name Search on the first RPI buyer as grantee, then read the grantor and any earlier deed
login_paul_must_do.do_not: Do not guess buyers or prices from Zillow, book-number order, or NEWCON permit dates.
